verdict.rationale: Daily's own docs name official client SDKs: daily-js for full UI control and Daily React for a hooks-based experience. Server-side room, token and recording control is also documented, and a published OpenAPI spec and llms.txt support AI-assisted building. The SDK evidence is a single thin mention, with no SDK reference depth, language coverage or server-side SDK shown, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented server-side/multi-language official SDKs, in-depth SDK reference evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Full control over your call UI with daily-js, or use Daily React for a hooks-based React experience.
Drop in a complete, customizable video call UI with a single line of code.
Create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings, and control calls from your server.
